claim: *Computation structure versus realized history.* The computation graph models declared computations and their typed composition; the per-session edit record logs the consequential mutations one run actually produced. They are separate reductions; a shared computation identity can join runtime edits to the static model when an engineering question requires that relation, without collapsing the two representations into one.

topology.description: Static computation DAG and realized edit sequence are peers; dashed undirected link marks not joined today.

Static structure and realized history; join by computation identity when a question needs it.
